sources.title: Charter of the United Nations (1945 text)
sources.access_level: Official UN treaty text; relevant passages parsed
sources.short_claim: Postwar international framework articulates rights without religious distinction and limits on force.
sources.limitations: Signature-year baseline; this lane does not audit enforcement, reservations or every later amendment.

sources.title: Charter of the International Military Tribunal
sources.access_level: Primary charter transcribed by Yale Avalon
sources.short_claim: Official position and superior orders do not erase individual responsibility under this tribunal charter.
sources.limitations: European Axis tribunal scope; not a universal finding about all postwar conduct.

sources.title: The Nuremberg Trials, 75 Years Later
sources.short_claim: Dates the major trial after WWII.
sources.limitations: Retrospective chronology; trial opening differs from August charter date.

sources.title: Executive Order 9835: federal employee loyalty program
sources.locator: Parts I–II; III.2–3; IV.2; V; VI.4
sources.short_claim: Civilian loyalty screening joins information across agencies; provides administrative hearing, counsel and appeal.
sources.limitations: Security can limit charge/source disclosure; temporary suspension allowed. Text is not an implementation audit.

sources.title: National Security Act of 1947, Public Law 80-253
sources.short_claim: Creates NSC/CIA and coordinated military structure under civilian control; CIA expressly lacks police and internal-security functions.
sources.limitations: Original enactment is July26; later organizational amendments are not backdated.

sources.title: Executive Order 9981: equality in armed services
sources.short_claim: Orders equal treatment regardless of race, color, religion or national origin and creates an implementation advisory committee.
sources.limitations: Order does not establish immediate compliance; archival account describes resistance.

sources.title: Uniform Code of Military Justice, 1952 United States Code edition
sources.access_level: Historical official code; relevant provisions parsed
sources.short_claim: May5,1950 enactment; May31,1951 effectiveness; civilian judges on Court of Military Appeals.
sources.limitations: 1952 edition is publication vintage, not enactment date; later amendments and current jurisdiction not audited.

sources.title: Emergency detention provisions: historical and repeal notes, Title50 Chapter23 SubchapterII
sources.access_level: Official indexed legislative-history notes; original 1950 PDF endpoint failed
sources.short_claim: Identifies September23,1950 detention/emergency provisions; 1971 original repeal independently inspected.
sources.limitations: Do not treat current compilation as original 1950 text. COMPS-10345 misleading discovery title led to TitlesI/III amended2006, excluded from evidentiary basis. Detailed powers/actual use not reconstructed.

sources.title: Public Law92-128: Non-Detention Act
sources.short_claim: Repeals Emergency Detention Act title and requires congressional authority for federal detention of citizens.
sources.limitations: Citizen-specific statutory protection; not an absolute detention prohibition and not a general noncitizen immigration remedy.

sources.title: The Immigration and Nationality Act of 1952
sources.locator: Quota, naturalization and Cold War debate paragraphs
sources.short_claim: Continues national-origins quotas while removing racial naturalization exclusions; documents security/exclusion debate.
sources.limitations: Retired and unmaintained history page; original act unavailable in this bounded retrieval.

sources.title: FRUS1952–1954, volumeI part2, document236 editorial note
sources.short_claim: INA enacted June27,1952 over veto; effective December24,1952.
sources.limitations: Edition publication date not established; source is editorial chronology rather than statute text.

sources.title: Overview of INS History
sources.locator: Indexed p7 phrase naming1954 Mexican-border enforcement initiative
sources.access_level: Agency history indexed excerpt; full PDF endpoint failed
sources.short_claim: Identifies1954 Operation Wetback as a targeted deportation initiative long before ICE.
sources.limitations: Only event existence/year used. No deportation totals, citizen-removal estimates or operational detail inferred from inaccessible full text. Historical official name contains a slur.

sources.title: Executive Order10631: Code of Conduct
sources.locator: Opening combat/captivity instruction; ArticleVI; amendment notes
sources.short_claim: Contains God language in a code addressed to combat and captivity.
sources.limitations: Displayed ArticleVI includes1988 amendment; do not present whole codified wording as verbatim1955 text or infer a general religious promotion test.

sources.title: Dwight Eisenhower farewell address
sources.locator: Transcript military establishment/armaments industry and unwarranted influence paragraphs
sources.short_claim: Warns that a permanent military-industrial relationship can acquire misplaced political power.
sources.limitations: Contemporaneous warning, not a quantified measure or proof about a later agency.

sources.title: Public Law89-236: Immigration and Nationality Act amendments1965
sources.locator: 79 Stat.911–922, §1 and preference provisions; House retrospective introduction
sources.access_level: Original law and official House historical page
sources.short_claim: Replaces national-origins quota allocation with a new admissions/preferences structure.
sources.limitations: Transition and numerical limits remain; not an end to immigration exclusion or enforcement. House page contains inconsistent image-caption Congress metadata, not relied upon.

sources.title: Welsh v. United States, 398 U.S.333
sources.short_claim: Reverses denial of conscientious objection for deeply held nontraditional moral/ethical convictions.
sources.limitations: Scope concerns sincere opposition to participation in war in any form; plurality statutory reasoning and concurrence differ. Not exemption for every policy disagreement.

sources.title: Laird v. Tatum, 408 U.S.1
sources.locator: Syllabus; majority pp10–16, especially specific harm discussion
sources.short_claim: Standing barrier defeats challenge based on subjective chill absent sufficient specific injury or threat.
sources.limitations: Jurisdiction/standing ruling does not approve every surveillance practice on its merits; dissents disagree.

sources.title: Senate history of the Church Committee
sources.locator: Investigation and outcome sections; April29,1976 report date;1976 committee and1978 FISA
sources.access_level: Official Senate historical account; original BookII download failed
sources.short_claim: Documents investigation of intelligence abuses and reforms including permanent legislative oversight.
sources.limitations: Historical synthesis, not complete original report review. No blanket inference that reforms eliminated abuse.

sources.title: Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act of1978, Public Law95-511
sources.short_claim: Creates designated court-order process and oversight for defined foreign-intelligence surveillance.
sources.limitations: Contains exceptions/defined scope; not a universal warrant requirement for every intelligence activity. Current law differs.

sources.title: Refugee Act of1980, National Archives document presentation
sources.locator: Document citation and contextual description; NAID24465841
sources.access_level: Archival enrolled-act presentation and official description; full statutory PDF failed
sources.short_claim: Builds a regular refugee admissions/resettlement framework around fear of persecution, with executive/congressional consultation.
sources.limitations: Publication_date records displayed original act date; this lane did not audit all18 scanned pages or later implementation.

sources.title: Military Cooperation With Civilian Law Enforcement Agencies, GAO testimony122004
sources.locator: PDFpp1–4:1981 law, earlier assistance, coordination and1982 DoD directive
sources.short_claim: December1,1981 legislation facilitates assistance; GAO observes increased involvement and coordination problems.
sources.limitations: Original PL97-86 not retrieved. GAO uses Posse Comitatus amendment shorthand; do not infer complete repeal of direct-enforcement limits.

sources.title: FY1997 National Defense Authorization Act, Public Law104-201
sources.short_claim: Authorizes transfer of excess DoD property, including arms, suitable for federal/state law-enforcement use.
sources.limitations: Authorization is not a count of actual recipients, transfers or missions. Original1996 rule distinct from later amendments.

sources.title: IIRIRA, divisionC of Public Law104-208
sources.short_claim: Delegated enforcement, expedited removal and closed-military-base detention pilot provisions precede ICE.
sources.limitations: Different provisions have different effective dates; §309 titleIII-A formula yieldsApril1,1997. No pilot implementation or current program prevalence established.

sources.title: Authorization for Use of Military Force, Public Law107-40
sources.short_claim: Authorizes force against specified9/11-connected nations, organizations or persons and harborers.
sources.limitations: Does not itself establish ICE or grant general immigration police authority; later interpretation not reconstructed here.

sources.title: USA PATRIOT Act, Public Law107-56
sources.short_claim: Adds security-certified noncitizen detention with proceedings deadline, periodic review and a specified habeas route.
sources.limitations: Selected clause only; no count of actual use or survey of later case law. Do not equate all immigration detention with this provision.

sources.title: Homeland Security Act of2002, Public Law107-296
sources.short_claim: Creates DHS and divides legacy immigration functions; abolishes INS after transfers and bars recombining the two specified bureaus.
sources.limitations: Enactment, department effectiveness and March2003 operational transfers are different milestones. No claim ICE is an armed service.

sources.title: Protecting the Homeland: Building a Layered and Coordinated Approach to Border Security, House hearing
sources.locator: ICE testimony Background III, parsed lines383–405
sources.short_claim: Dates ICE formation toMarch1,2003 and describes combination of legacy INS and Customs enforcement functions.
sources.limitations: Descriptive leadership testimony is interested evidence, not independent validation of claimed effectiveness;2004 organizational description not assumed current.
